column1: # perf-rename-4: NEW rows (rvas not in symbols.tsv) naming the last unnamed functions of the perf_coverage.py views (attributed + --self). Evidence from decomp/disassembly callers, callees and strings in each description. (perf-rename-3 was already used by the GPU-pass round.)
